You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier. Its prompt is the case row verbatim, the scenario registry path (apps/playground/src/scenarios/registry.tsx), the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and this fence: read only packages/basalt-ui/agent/**, packages/basalt-ui/llms.txt, the published subpaths' types and docs and the playground's own code except other apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr/** directories; never docs/v3/**, docs/v3/evidence/ext-tuffui-devices.md, .claude/shots/**, .evidence/** or any TuffUI source; import basalt-ui through published subpaths only and nothing from @mantine; mark every workaround `// cycle-expression-3: <what the kit lacked>`; return the files written and a list of what it wanted from the kit or the skill and did not find. Run builders one after another or on disjoint files; each adds one registry and one scenario-info entry. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts. (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case, never the builder. Its prompt is the case row, the shot paths, the scenario file paths, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md, and for a c case the reference shot from docs/v3/expression/references.md (re-take it from the URL there if the file is missing).
